ThingDef.label: vekkra choker
ThingDef.description: A small, pale mushroom with a swollen cap pitted like a skull, and a smaller relative of the grath elder. Its steady haze of toxic spores chokes creatures without poison immunity and fouls the surrounding ground. Clear it from paths and fields with poison protection or fire.

ThingDef.label: sikkra lure
ThingDef.description: At night, tiny teal-glowing caps lure gnats and moths onto sticky gills, where they are slowly digested. By morning, a busy patch is furred with wings. The caps are harmless to touch and worthless to eat.

ThingDef.label: pimmik mold
ThingDef.description: The fruiting bodies of a pale mold that carpets the forest floor wherever the mat is warm: a fuzz of tiny pins, each with a bead of a head. It is the most common thing in the biome and the least noticed.

ThingDef.label: nissik gill
ThingDef.description: A near-black cap whose gills glow brightly beneath it, throwing light down onto the milky water it stands in and none at all upward, so that a stand of them looks from above like a shoal of dark stones lit from below. It grows in the shallows, or in ground wet enough to pass for them.

ThingDef.label: nissik gill
ThingDef.description: While its cap's exterior is largely dark in color, its underside glows brightly. It grows most often in water or extremely wet environments.

ThingDef.label: rukka cap
ThingDef.description: A damp-ground mushroom with a cap wrinkled and folded like a walnut, glowing a soft lilac from deep in the folds. It is the grazers' staple: anything in the pale forest that eats fungus eats this first, and a field of trampled rukka caps is a sure sign a herd is near.

ThingDef.label: rukka cap
ThingDef.description: A subterranean fungus that grows in damp environments. It is often eaten by fungivores.

ThingDef.label: churrun mast
ThingDef.description: A mast of pale fungus standing in the milk ponds, lit from inside with a cold blue-green light. It grows fast and cuts into mushroom logs, though not many; mostly it is the thing you steer by across the shallows.

ThingDef.label: churrun mast
ThingDef.description: Fast-growing, but doesn't yield much usable material. Aquatic fungus.

ThingDef.label: brommok timber
ThingDef.description: A massive marsh mushroom with a trunk as hard as wood, rooted in the milk ponds and growing fast enough to see. It cuts into ordinary wood, though not much of it for its size; it will only grow on soft, wet ground.

ThingDef.label: brommok timber
ThingDef.description: A strong wood-like mushroom. Fast-growing, but doesn't yield much usable material. It can only be grown by people on marshy soil.

ThingDef.label: tarrusk spire
ThingDef.description: A slow-growing fungus with a tall purple-grey cap that peels into ragged flakes. Its hard, straight-grained stalk can be cut into strong building timber.

ThingDef.label: gubbra gourd
ThingDef.description: A bloated grey-green fungus shaped like a gourd, its skin stretched tight over sacs of a foul yellow liquid that slosh when it is touched. Step on one and you will smell it for a day. Nothing eats it, and nothing has to.

ThingDef.label: rustpuff
ThingDef.description: A large puffball mushroom that bursts at a touch into a cloud of flaky, rust-coloured spores. The spores stain everything and harm nothing; the forest floor is red-brown wherever a herd has walked through a patch.

ThingDef.label: aumbri
ThingDef.description: The aumbri is the common tall mushroom of the pale forest: a lilac cap on a thick white stalk, studded with soft knobs that glow faintly when the air is wet. Where it grows thick it makes a low, dim roof that much of the forest's smaller life shelters under. It gives a handful of edible purple caps when harvested.

ThingDef.label: aumbri cap
ThingDef.description: The soft purple caps of the aumbri, cut from the stalk. Edible raw, better cooked.

ThingDef.label: tavvik crust
ThingDef.description: A tough, leafy grey-green crust that clings to rock and fungal mat alike in overlapping scales, living on almost no light. Nothing much eats it and nothing much kills it. When the ground turns cold and everything else in the pale forest sickens back into the mat, the tavvik crust is the last thing still growing.

ThingDef.label: rhukk tooth
ThingDef.description: A large, blunt, tooth-white mushroom that beads and drips a red fluid thick as blood from every pore of its cap. It is harmless and it is not bleeding; nobody who sees one for the first time believes either.

ThingDef.label: redsong
ThingDef.description: A broad, flat crimson cap on a tall white stalk, the one strong colour in a pale forest and visible from a long way off. It is not food, medicine or timber; it is good for nothing but looking at, and it is very good at that. Colonists plant it for the pleasure of seeing it.

ThingDef.label: sylla lace
ThingDef.description: A slender grey-blue mushroom with fine lace hanging from beneath its cap to the ground. The strong, soft fibres can be harvested for cloth, and the fungus grows in open ground or fungiponic beds.

ThingDef.label: dremmik cap
ThingDef.description: A large slow-growing mushroom that lives in symbiosis with a surprisingly tasty slime mold, which spreads in glimmering sheets across its cap and is scraped off and eaten. The mushroom takes a full season to mature; the slime comes back in days.

ThingDef.label: glimmerslime
ThingDef.description: Glimmerslime is a slime mold, not a real mushroom at all. It lives in symbiosis with the shinecaps.

ThingDef.label: tinnik bell
ThingDef.description: A small mushroom whose nodding bells glow honey-gold from within. Colonists grow it beside paths and doors for light and a small edible harvest.

ThingDef.label: pursk hood
ThingDef.description: A large violet mushroom whose cap folds down around the stalk like a hood. Common throughout the pale forest, it yields a small harvest of soft, edible cap flesh.

ThingDef.label: ambrosyx
ThingDef.description: A small, soft, pale-gold mushroom that grows in loose rings on rich warm ground under the forest roof. It is rare and slow, and every colony that finds a ring guards it, because its caps are the ambrosyx shroom: wonderful to eat, gently euphoric, and habit-forming if eaten too often. Picked carefully, a ring fruits again.

ThingDef.label: yullcomb
ThingDef.description: A small, brittle fungus with a pale, honeycombed cap and a pale stalk. Its slow-growing flesh is used in fungal medicine and must be harvested carefully. A productive patch is guarded like a medicine cabinet.

ThingDef.label: yullcomb
ThingDef.description: The yullcomb grown in prepared beds: a small honeycombed mushroom whose flesh is worked into fungal medicine. Sowing and harvesting it are both slow, careful work, because the whole thing crumbles at a careless touch into a dust worth nothing.

ThingDef.label: fungal medicine
ThingDef.description: A pack of fungal concoctions extracted from the mortal morel. It is less potent than industrial pharmaceuticals, but much better than nothing.

ThingDef.label: moonless stripes
ThingDef.description: Heat-loving and durable, this bizarre fungus thrives in the depths of the earth. While it can be grown anywhere, it requires high heat to grow properly and no light at all. Its sturdy layered stalk can be used as a leathery textile.

ThingDef.label: moonless leather
ThingDef.description: Tanned, dried, scraped mushroom layers. A good underground material for making clothes and bags.

ThingDef.label: tamma sweetcap
ThingDef.description: An oddly sweet mushroom grown in place of berries by everyone who lives under a roof of rock or spores. It tolerates cold, heat and filth, and its caps are eaten raw, dried, or stewed into the one dish every cantina on the night shoulder serves.

ThingDef.label: dulcis
ThingDef.description: Dulcis mushrooms. Nice to eat, even raw, if you like fungus.

ThingDef.label: kabbrik pod
ThingDef.description: A low cluster of taut, rounded pods on short stems, the skins grey-white and glossy, each seam showing a faint warm glow. The pods are packed with an oily spore-mass volatile enough to refine into chemfuel, and colonists learn to keep fires well away from a patch. It grows where it pleases and nowhere anyone plants it; nobody has managed to cultivate it.

ThingDef.label: blast spore sac
ThingDef.description: The spore sac of a blastpod fungus. It's a good fuel for campfires and generators, and can be refined into chemfuel.
